title.fil: Paglibot sa lugar ng trabaho at bentilasyon

purpose.fil: Tukuyin ang panganib at angkop na pag-iwas.

materials.en: Trainer-approved local environmental and ventilation checklist
materials.fil: Lokal na checklist sa kapaligiran at bentilasyon na aprubado ng trainer

steps.en: Use the deck's needlestick picture question and discuss its answer.
steps.fil: Gamitin ang tanong na may larawan ng needlestick sa deck at talakayin ang sagot.

steps.en: Inspect a fictional layout or supervised safe area: wet floor, blocked exit, missing soap, waste and ventilation concerns.
steps.fil: Suriin ang kathang layout o ligtas na lugar na may superbisyon: basang sahig, harang na exit, walang sabon, basura at bentilasyon.

steps.en: Name harm, control and reporting contact. Use local criteria instead of guessing that ventilation is adequate.
steps.fil: Tukuyin ang pinsala, pag-iwas at pagsasabihan. Gamitin ang lokal na pamantayan sa halip na manghula sa bentilasyon.

debrief.en: What can be corrected now and what needs the supervisor?
debrief.fil: Ano ang maaayos ngayon at ano ang kailangan ng supervisor?

observe.en: Names hazard, harm, protocol and contact; checks supplies and the work area.
observe.fil: Natutukoy ang panganib, pinsala, protocol at contact; nasusuri ang kagamitan at lugar.

output.en: Practice checklist with a follow-up action.

alternative.en: Use a drawn BHS layout instead of entering a work area.
alternative.fil: Gumamit ng iginuhit na BHS sa halip na pumasok sa lugar.

worksheet.en: Hazard / harm / control / contact / follow-up / verification
worksheet.fil: Panganib / pinsala / pag-iwas / contact / follow-up / pagtitiyak

purpose.en: Demonstrate the selected skill using approved local procedures.
purpose.fil: Ipakita ang napiling kasanayan gamit ang aprubadong lokal na procedure.

materials.en: Dummy equipment and display sharps container; no used needles
materials.fil: Dummy equipment at display sharps container; walang gamit na karayom

steps.en: Trainer prepares equipment and checks the protocol before the session.
steps.fil: Ihanda ng trainer ang kagamitan at suriin ang protocol bago ang session.

steps.en: Show container placement and its fill line, then rehearse an incident-reporting call under local protocol.
steps.fil: Ipakita ang lalagyan at fill line, saka magsanay sa pagtawag para iulat ang insidente ayon sa lokal na protocol.

steps.en: Each learner repeats while observed. Pause and correct unsafe actions, explain the correction and offer another attempt.
steps.fil: Ulitin ng bawat mag-aaral habang inoobserbahan. Ihinto at iwasto ang di-ligtas na kilos, ipaliwanag at bigyan ng muling pagkakataon.

debrief.en: What would make you pause and ask for help?
debrief.fil: Ano ang dahilan para huminto at humingi ng tulong?

observe.en: Use the approved checklist. Record only what was observed; a combined indicator needs all its actions observed before a full competency rating.
observe.fil: Gamitin ang aprubadong checklist. Itala lamang ang nakita; kailangang makita ang lahat ng kilos sa pinagsamang indicator bago ang buong rating.

output.en: Individual demonstration notes and repeat-practice needs.
output.fil: Tala ng indibidwal na demo at kailangang uliting practice.

alternative.en: Without equipment or approved guidance, discuss preparation only, mark adapted and schedule the demonstration. Do not record demonstrated competence.
alternative.fil: Kung walang kagamitan o aprubadong gabay, paghahanda lamang, markahang inangkop at itakda ang demo. Huwag itala na naipakita ang kakayahan.

steps.en: Adjust the chair and bag; show a comfortable trainer-selected movement break. No forced stretching or exercise prescription.

title.fil: Dami ng gawain at tahimik na pahinga

purpose.en: Practise asking for support and a manageable pause.
purpose.fil: Magsanay humingi ng suporta at kayang pahinga.

steps.en: Card: the room is busy, supplies are limited and an extra visit is requested.
steps.fil: Card: abala ang lugar, kulang ang kagamitan at may dagdag na pagdalaw.

steps.en: In pairs, explain the workload and ask the supervisor what to pause, reassign or reschedule.
steps.fil: Magkapareha: ipaliwanag ang gawain at itanong sa supervisor ang ihihinto, ililipat o ililipat ng oras.

steps.en: Offer an optional quiet seated pause. Learners can rest or decline; no personal disclosure or breathing technique is required.
steps.fil: Mag-alok ng opsyonal na tahimik na pahinga habang nakaupo. Maaaring magpahinga o tumanggi; walang sapilitang pagbabahagi o breathing technique.

debrief.en: What support or boundary would make work manageable?
debrief.fil: Anong suporta o hangganan ang makatutulong sa gawain?

observe.en: For practice and feedback; no standalone competency rating.
observe.fil: Para sa pagsasanay at puna; walang hiwalay na rating.

output.en: One support request and next step.
output.fil: Isang hiling na suporta at susunod na hakbang.

alternative.fil: Payagan ang pribadong pagsulat ng plano.

worksheet.en: Workload / task to discuss / support request / agreed next step
worksheet.fil: Gawain / dapat talakayin / hiling na suporta / napagkasunduang hakbang
